financials_interim.notes: EAST WEST PROPERTIES PLC COMPANY (standalone parent, property-leasing/Property segment only) basis, three months ended 30 June 2026. Company Income Statement p.3, SOFP p.5, Cash Flow p.9. Revenue Rs.33,487,276, +12.71% YoY (2025: Rs.29,709,859) -- rental/lease income only, no cost_of_sales/gross_profit line disclosed at Company level (no COGS breakout for property leasing). Administrative Expenses fell 55.1% YoY (Rs.23,969,926 to Rs.10,761,338, a Rs.13,208,588 decline) -- the same unexplained cost decline identified at Group level, concentrated at the Company/Property-segment level (13.21mn of the Group's 15.38mn admin-expense decline, i.e. 86%, originates here). Profit from Operating Activities +265.7% YoY (Rs.6,752,980 to Rs.24,696,426). PBT +140.9% YoY (Rs.18,135,340 to Rs.43,688,249); PAT +151.5% YoY (Rs.15,135,340 to Rs.38,068,243). EPS 0.28 cross-checked: 38,068,243/138,240,000=0.2754, rounds to 0.28. No borrowings on the Company balance sheet either (Bank Overdrafts = 0 both periods) -- short_term_borrowings/long_term_borrowings stored as 0. current_assets/current_liabilities computed by summing SOFP face lines (current_assets: Trade & Other Receivables 46,012,026 + Amounts Due From Related Parties 49,956 + Short Term Investments 603,358,411 + Cash & Cash Equivalents 59,744,498 = 709,164,891; current_liabilities: Trade & Other Payables 26,066,276 + Deposits & Advances Received 1,601,426 + Income Tax Liabilities 11,897,948 = 39,565,650); both tie to Total Assets/Total Equity+Liabilities as printed.

Source: EAST WEST PROPERTIES PLC Interim Financial Statements, three months ended 30 June 2026 (filed CSE 12-Aug-2026). FYE 31 March. Consolidated Income Statement p.2, Consolidated SOFP p.4, Consolidated Cash Flow p.8, Operating Segment Information p.10 (labelled 'FOR THE QUATER ENDED 30TH JUNE 2026' in the filing -- current quarter only, no segmental PY comparative given). GROUP basis. MAPPING: the Income Statement's 4th numeric column (unlabelled 'Rs.' after the '%change' column) is the FY ended 31.03.2026 (prior full year, e.g. Revenue 160,158,752 and a Rs.197,000,000 'Fair Value Gain on Investment Property' booked at FYE) -- NOT a second comparator for this quarter; only the first two columns (2026 quarter, 2025 quarter) were used for all figures and the YoY comparison. Both this quarter and the prior-year quarter show a NIL 'Fair Value Gain on Investment Property' line (the Rs.197,000,000 gain is a FY2025/26 year-end event only), so no revaluation gain distorts either quarter's operating profit. cost_of_sales=215,341 is the 'Direct Cost' line. finance_costs stored as 0: no distinct 'Finance Cost' line is presented for Group (only 'Finance Income'/'Net Finance Income'), and Net Finance Income (19,870,792) equals Finance Income exactly, i.e., Group carries no interest-bearing borrowings this period (Interest Bearing Borrowings cash-flow line is nil both periods; Bank Overdraft = 0) -- short_term_borrowings/long_term_borrowings both stored as 0, not blank, since the nil-debt position is explicitly evidenced (BS shows no borrowings line item at all). EPS 0.30 cross-checked: profit attributable to parent 40,846,927 / 138,240,000 shares (Stated Capital note, BS p.4) = 0.2955, rounds to 0.30 as printed; no separate diluted EPS is disclosed, eps_diluted stored equal to eps_basic. SEGMENTAL (Note, p.10, current quarter only): Property segment (=Company, property leasing/rental) Segment Revenue Rs.33,487,276 (77.7% of Group) and Segment Profit Rs.24,696,426 (80.7% of Group Rs.30,585,856); Media segment (Peoples Media Network (Pvt) Ltd subsidiary) Segment Revenue Rs.9,777,625 (22.3%) and Segment Profit Rs.5,889,429 (19.3%). The segment table's 'External Revenue' row (Property 29,548,198 / Media 9,777,625) does not sum to the Group Total of 43,103,240 -- this is an apparent labelling error in the filing itself (likely 'External Revenue' for Property should read the same 33,487,276 as 'Segment Revenue'); the Group Total column of 43,103,240 instead ties out exactly via Segment Revenue (33,487,276+9,777,625) less Inter-Segment Revenue (161,662) = 43,103,239 (~43,103,240 rounding), which is independently verified against the primary Consolidated Income Statement's own Revenue line -- treated as a genuine filing artifact, not an extraction error on our part, and not material to any figure stored here. DRIVER: Group Profit from Operating Activities rose Rs.22,874,370 YoY (Rs.7,711,486 to Rs.30,585,856, +296.6%); this decomposes exactly into a Rs.15,379,219 fall in Administrative Expenses (Rs.29,730,883 to Rs.14,351,664, -51.7%, unexplained in the filing -- no MD&A/cost note given, a genuine disclosure gap), a Rs.7,099,771 rise in Gross Profit (+19.8%), and a Rs.395,379 rise in Other Income -- the Admin Expense decline alone is 67.2% of the operating-profit swing. current_assets and current_liabilities are not printed as single lines and were computed by summing the itemised current asset/liability lines on the face of the SOFP (current_assets: Inventories 1,165,760 + Trade & Other Receivables 78,183,553 + Short Term Investments 623,358,411 + Cash & Cash Equivalents 66,079,308 = 768,787,032; current_liabilities: Trade & Other Payables 33,598,765 + Rent Received in Advance 1,601,426 + Income Tax Liabilities 13,743,193 = 48,943,384); both cross-check exactly against Total Assets = Non-Current + Current and Total Equity+Liabilities identity.

interim_updates.note_text: East West Properties PLC (EAST) reported Group Revenue of Rs.43,103,240 for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, +19.99% YoY (2025: Rs.35,921,664). Group Profit from Operating Activities nearly quadrupled, +296.63% YoY to Rs.30,585,856 (2025: Rs.7,711,486) -- this swing decomposes exactly into a Rs.15,379,219 fall in Administrative Expenses (Rs.29,730,883 to Rs.14,351,664, -51.73%, 67% of the operating-profit improvement and UNEXPLAINED anywhere in the filing -- no MD&A/cost commentary is given, a genuine disclosure gap), a Rs.7,099,771 rise in Gross Profit (+19.84%), and a Rs.395,379 rise in Other Income. No fair value gain/loss on investment property was booked in EITHER quarter (the Rs.197,000,000 FV gain shown in the filing's separate FY2025/26 reference column was a year-end-only event, not part of this quarter's result) -- so, unusually for a real estate company, this quarter's earnings swing is a pure operating-cost story, not a revaluation story. Group PBT grew 131.74% YoY to Rs.50,456,648 (2025: Rs.21,772,894), further aided by Finance Income +41.31% YoY to Rs.19,870,792 (2025: Rs.14,061,408) -- EAST carries no interest-bearing borrowings (Bank Overdraft nil both periods), so this is a pure investment-income line, not a net-of-debt figure. Income Tax Expense grew 61.77% YoY to Rs.6,940,005 (2025: Rs.4,290,000). Group PAT grew 148.91% YoY to Rs.43,516,643 (2025: Rs.17,482,894); EPS grew to Rs.0.30 from Rs.0.12. SEGMENTAL (current quarter only, no PY segmental comparative disclosed): Property segment (=Company, rental/leasing) contributed Rs.33,487,276 of Segment Revenue (77.7% of Group) and Rs.24,696,426 of Segment Profit (80.7%); Media segment (Peoples Media Network (Pvt) Ltd subsidiary) contributed Rs.9,777,625 of Segment Revenue (22.3%) and Rs.5,889,429 of Segment Profit (19.3%). At the COMPANY (Property segment) level, Revenue grew a more modest +12.71% YoY to Rs.33,487,276, while Administrative Expenses fell 55.10% YoY (Rs.23,969,926 to Rs.10,761,338, a Rs.13,208,588 decline representing 86% of the Group's total admin-expense decline) -- confirming the Property/Company entity is the source of the unexplained cost reduction driving Group profit growth. Company PBT +140.9% YoY (Rs.18,135,340 to Rs.43,688,249); Company PAT +151.5% YoY (Rs.15,135,340 to Rs.38,068,243); Company EPS Rs.0.28 (2025: Rs.0.11).
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: EAST's prior on-file document (period ended 30 September 2020) was over 5 years stale before this refresh -- the CSE API in fact shows regular recent filings (documents for quarters ended 30 June 2025, filed 14-Aug-2025, and 30 September 2025, filed 14-Nov-2025, plus this 30 June 2026 filing) confirming EAST is an actively trading, actively disclosing company; the staleness was purely a local sourcing gap, NOT suspension, delisting risk, or non-disclosure -- no closer prior quarter has yet been entered into financial_statements/interim_updates to support a QoQ comparison, only this fresh entry. Genuine filing-level gaps: (1) the Rs.15,379,219 (Group) / Rs.13,208,588 (Company) YoY fall in Administrative Expenses -- the dominant driver of this quarter's profit growth -- is not explained anywhere in the filing (no MD&A/notes commentary on cost drivers at all in this interim report); (2) the Operating Segment Information table's 'External Revenue' row for the Property segment (Rs.29,548,198) does not sum with Media's Rs.9,777,625 to the printed Group Total of Rs.43,103,240 -- an apparent labelling error in the filing itself (the Group Total instead ties exactly to Segment Revenue less Inter-Segment Revenue, independently cross-checked against the primary Consolidated Income Statement); (3) no segmental PY comparative is disclosed, so segment-level YoY growth cannot be computed, only the current-quarter segment mix; (4) current_assets/current_liabilities are not printed as single lines and were computed by summing itemised SOFP face lines, cross-checked to tie exactly to Total Assets and Total Equity+Liabilities.
interim_updates.takeaway: EAST's headline 149% PAT growth is real but is driven mostly by a large, entirely unexplained fall in Administrative Expenses (-51.73% YoY, Rs.15.38mn) rather than by revenue growth (+19.99%) or property revaluation (nil this quarter, unlike the FY2025/26 year-end which booked a Rs.197mn gain) -- this is worth querying directly with the company since no note in the filing explains the cost reduction, and a one-off cost item reversing next quarter would flatter the YoY comparison unsustainably. The company itself is unambiguously actively trading and filing on a normal quarterly cadence (confirmed via CSE's own filing history showing June-2025, September-2025, and June-2026 quarters all filed on time) -- the prior 5-year-stale local document was a sourcing gap on this platform, not a sign of any disclosure problem at EAST. EAST remains debt-free (no interest-bearing borrowings), so its profit quality is supported by real balance-sheet strength even setting the cost-decline question aside.
operational_highlights: Group Revenue Rs.43,103,240, +19.99% YoY (2025: Rs.35,921,664); Group Profit from Operating Activities Rs.30,585,856, +296.63% YoY (2025: Rs.7,711,486); Group PBT Rs.50,456,648, +131.74% YoY; Group PAT Rs.43,516,643, +148.91% YoY.
Administrative Expenses fell 51.73% YoY (Group: Rs.29,730,883 to Rs.14,351,664, a Rs.15,379,219 decline) -- 67% of the operating-profit improvement, and entirely unexplained in the filing.

No fair value gain/loss on investment property was recognised in either the current or prior-year quarter -- this quarter's profit surge is a cost/operating story, not a revaluation story (unusual for a real estate company).
EAST carries no interest-bearing borrowings (Bank Overdraft nil both periods); Finance Income grew 41.31% YoY to Rs.19,870,792, a pure investment-income contribution to PBT.
Property segment (=Company) generated 77.7% of Group segment revenue and 80.7% of Group segment profit this quarter; Media segment (Peoples Media Network) contributed the remaining 22.3%/19.3%.
Company-level Administrative Expenses fell 55.10% YoY (Rs.23,969,926 to Rs.10,761,338) -- 86% of the Group's total admin-expense decline originates at the Company/Property-segment level.
key_drivers: Administrative Expense decline of Rs.15,379,219 YoY (Group, -51.73%) is the single largest driver of the operating-profit swing (67% of the Rs.22,874,370 increase), concentrated at the Company/Property segment (86% of the decline originates there) -- cause not disclosed in the filing.
Revenue and Gross Profit growth of +19.84% (Rs.7,099,771 increase) is a genuine, secondary contributor (31% of the operating-profit swing).

Finance Income growth of +41.31% YoY (Rs.5,809,384 increase) accounted for exactly the remainder of the Rs.28,683,754 PBT increase beyond the operating-profit swing -- EAST's investment/cash balances are a meaningful and growing profit contributor for a debt-free company.
